title.ru: Cleveland Review of Books представил Killing Orpheus Форестера Макклэтчи
title.en: Cleveland Review of Books reviews Forester McClatchey’s Killing Orpheus

summary.en: Cleveland Review of Books has published Lucas Jorgensen’s review of Forester McClatchey’s Killing Orpheus. The 81-page Carnegie Mellon University Press collection appeared in February 2026. The new review considers classical stories through Isaac, Hannibal and Penelope, asking how ancient narratives help poetry address the present.

source.name: Cleveland Review of Books
source.title: When Green Things Talk: On Forester McClatchey’s “Killing Orpheus”

title.ru: Mercurio опубликовал интервью с Висенте Луисом Морой о Nosotras
title.en: Mercurio interviews Vicente Luis Mora about Nosotras

summary.en: Mercurio has interviewed Vicente Luis Mora about Nosotras, published by Galaxia Gutenberg in 2026. The conversation examines formal experimentation, the play with plausibility and a portrayal of the publishing world through the Sant Jordi festival.

source.title: Vicente Luis Mora: «Hay una inflación de escrituras presuntamente terapéuticas»

title.ru: Books Ireland опубликовал фрагмент Beyond Ourselves о Мюриэл Ракейзер
title.en: Books Ireland shares a Beyond Ourselves extract on Muriel Rukeyser

summary.en: Books Ireland has published an extract from Catherine Gander’s essay in Beyond Ourselves: Contemporary Poets on Muriel Rukeyser. source.title: ‘Rukeyser describes the reawakening of deep knowledge that a poem can evoke’-Catherine Gander

title.ru: Buchkultur представил Mio und die Unsterblichkeit Паулюса Хохгаттерера
title.en: Buchkultur reviews Paulus Hochgatterer’s Mio und die Unsterblichkeit

summary.en: Buchkultur has reviewed Paulus Hochgatterer’s Mio und die Unsterblichkeit. In the 144-page novel, sixteen-year-old Ingemar narrates his family and surrounding world, while Mio is a cat with nine lives. source.name: Buchkultur
source.title: Paulus Hochgatterer

title.ru: Minima & moralia разобрал роман W. Тимена Химстры
title.en: Minima & moralia reviews Tiemen Hiemstra’s W.

source.name: minima&moralia
source.title: W., o di ciò che rimane di un’amicizia

summary.en: Recours au poème has published Michel Herland’s review of Xavier Bordes’s Sur le sentier des Cinq Montagnes. source.title: Xavier Bordes, Sur le sentier des Cinq Montagnes - Poésie

source.title: Book Stuff: Sci-fi writer Naomi Kritzer on a future without OBs

summary.en: Fremantle Press has announced its acquisition of The Season with Snaps Truly and opened preorders. title.en: Guernica publishes Liane Strauss’s essay on reading Emily Dickinson

summary.en: Guernica has published Liane Strauss’s essay on Emily Dickinson’s I felt a Funeral, in my Brain. She compares twenty years of reading the poem with a short AI search overview. The new critical piece examines changing perceptions of loss, rhythm and the final stanza, considering the questions that remain open when a reader repeatedly returns to the same work.

title.en: Cleveland Review of Books shares an extract from Matt Turner’s 6AMING

source.title: From “6AMING”
